name: Pyrokinetic Surge
text:
Target an enemy model in range.

Make an attack roll against the target model. If the attack hits, the model hit suffers the Fire continuous effect in addition to suffering a damage roll. Additionally, the two closest models within 2” of the target suffer the Fire continuous effect.

This Fury causes fire damage.
changes: The two closest models within 2" now also suffer the Fire continuous effect.
